newsitem.title: INDIA: India to release wheat, rice to check price rise.
newsitem.headline: India to release wheat, rice to check price rise.

text.p: India's grain procurement agency will release 396,000 tonnes of wheat and 171,000 tonnes of rice for domestic sales in October to control prices, the agency said in a statement on Tuesday.
The state-owned Food Corporation of India (FCI) said it had been authorised by the government to intervene in the market to "reverse the inflationary trends in the price of wheat and rice."
"The corporation will be releasing 396,000 tonnes of wheat and 171,000 tonnes of rice in the open market during October, 1996," FCI said.
The agency said it would continue to monitor the price trends in the open market for both commodities and intervene when necessary.
